Welcome to the map ze_ocarina_of_time , inspired by the legendary game The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time! This map will transport you to the amazing world of Hyrule, where you will find 10 unique levels filled with the atmosphere of the iconic RPG. Each level is a separate location that perfectly captures the spirit of the original game.
_____________________________________

Features of the map:

 10 levels

 Vast locations that were featured in the game

 Atmospheric music and sounds from the original game, creating full immersion
_____________________________________

This map is perfect for Zombie Escape enthusiasts looking for something new and unusual. Here, you will find elements of exploration that will make every round unforgettable.
_____________________________________

If you're looking for a map with large locations and the atmosphere of the legendary Zelda, then ze_ocarina_of_time is exactly what you need! Join the game and dive into a world of adventure, where each level is a new challenge and new experiences.
